claim: Former New York State Assemblyman and New York City Councilman
finding: Served three Assembly terms and two Council terms representing eastern Queens.

claim: Served as New York State Special Counsel for Ratepayer Protection, overseeing the PSC
finding: He held the post, created in 2020 at the Department of Public Service. The Special Counsel reported to the Commission rather than overseeing it.

claim: Helped impose record fines on PSEG
finding: PSEG Long Island forfeited $30 million over its Isaias response in a LIPA settlement; Lancman held forums and gathered evidence on the harm. The site gives no figure and calls it a fine.

claim: Vice Chairman of the Nassau County Interim Finance Authority
Elected Great Neck Library trustee and served two years as president
finding: The Island 360 reported him serving as library board president.

claim: Served in New York's 42nd Infantry Division
finding: No public service record was found in this review.

claim: Championed hiring more than 1,000 new NYPD officers
finding: Shared budget credit as a Council member; Branch Politics records the same claim from his site.

claim: Helped establish two new water authorities to lower rates
finding: He led the state study on municipalizing a Nassau water company, per LIPA's staff page, but no source confirmed his role in creating two authorities.
